sources.title: Northfield Institute: hostel allotment page
sources.text:
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE SOURCE: written for the Blunder Check demo. Northfield Institute is fictional.

Northfield Institute: Hostel Allotment 2026-27
Last updated: 20 July 2026

Hostel fee for the academic year 2026-27 is Rs. 68,000, payable in two instalments. The first instalment is due at the time of allotment and the second is due by 15 January 2027.

Eligibility: First-year students admitted through the main counselling round are eligible. Allotment is made on a first-come, first-served basis after fee payment.

Required documents: admission letter, two passport-size photographs, and a parent or guardian declaration form.

Hostel gates close at 9:30 PM on weekdays.

For hostel queries, contact the Chief Warden's office.

sources.text:
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE SOURCE: written for the Blunder Check demo. Northfield Institute is fictional.

Northfield Students Forum: "Hostel FAQ for freshers"
Posted: 2 August 2026

Hey everyone! Quick summary of what seniors told me. The hostel fee is Rs. 72,000 for the year including mess charges. Rooms are shared by three students. You need your admission letter and a medical fitness certificate on the day of allotment. Gates close around 10 PM, but nobody really checks.

Pro tip: Pay the fee early, otherwise you may lose your room.

Published: June 2025

Hostel fee for the academic year 2025-26 is Rs. 61,000 including mess charges, payable in a single instalment before 10 August 2025.

Hostel rooms are allotted to first-year and second-year students. Hostel gates close at 9:00 PM.

Students who leave the hostel permanently during the year must inform the warden in writing.
